verdict.rationale: Datadog is a SaaS observability platform, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. The evidence shows a dedicated first-party MCP server documentation page (probe confirms 'official MCP server documented' and a markdown version of /mcp_server/ exists). The pack contains nothing about how to connect an agent, which tools are exposed, authentication, or hands-on use, so only the server's existence is established. missing for 10: connection/setup instructions, exposed tools and scope, authentication details, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://docs.datadoghq.com/mcp_server/
